Fix `plugins/notifications/src/components/NotificationsTable/NotificationsTable.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Defect in the highlighted block, found with a test: on a fresh load of `?id=<id>` whose lookup succeeds and whose notification has a description, the table stays on 'No records to display' while its heading reads 'Unread notifications (5)' and its pager reads '1-5 of 5', so the rows never appear, even after waiting 10 seconds. Reproduced on every run. With no description the same case renders all 5 rows, and with no `?id=` rows render normally. Cause: `NotificationDescription` is a swappable component built on `lazy()` and createSwappableComponent adds no Suspense boundary, so inside the highlighted block it suspends the surrounding tree on first load and the table misses its update. Fix: add `Suspense` to the existing import from 'react', and wrap the highlighted block's content in `<Suspense fallback={null}>`, inside `{highlightedNotification && (...)}`, so that the block suspends on its own and the Table beside it keeps rendering. Change nothing else: with no `highlightedNotification` the output and behaviour stay exactly as they are, and the block stays outside the Table.

Fix `plugins/notifications/src/components/UnreadNotificationsCard/UnreadNotificationsCard.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Every error below is in the file as it stands; fix all of them. (1) yarn tsc: UnreadNotificationsCard.test.tsx:19:10 - error TS2305: Module '"@backstage/core-plugin-api"' has no exported member 'toastApiRef'. Import `toastApiRef` from `@backstage/frontend-plugin-api`, as the card does. (2) yarn tsc: UnreadNotificationsCard.test.tsx:54:5 - error TS2322: Type 'boolean' is not assignable to type 'Date'. (3) yarn tsc: UnreadNotificationsCard.test.tsx:545:8 - error TS6133: 'res' is declared but its value is never read: remove it. (4) The `createNotification` fixture has no `payload`, so the card crashes with a TypeError at `notification.payload.severity` (UnreadNotificationsCard.tsx:154). Rebuild it as `{ id, user: 'user:default/john', created: new Date('2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'), origin: 'plugin-test', payload: { title }, ...overrides }`: no top-level `title`, no `read` line. Update every use of the fixture to match, so that nothing reads a top-level `title`. (5) In 'shows the loading, empty and error states inside the card', `expect(await screen.findByText(/Network error loading notifications/)).toBeInTheDocument()` fails because ResponseErrorPanel renders the message in the panel title and again in its details. Use `screen.findAllByText(/Network error loading notifications/)` and assert the result is not empty, and make sure earlier renders in that test are unmounted first. Keep every other assertion.
